name: GO Track
market: United Arab Emirates   ·   Fleet telematics operator
headline: A fleet platform taken bilingual for the GCC market
challenge: GO Track operated a capable English-only fleet management portal. Across the GCC, Arabic support is frequently a mandatory qualification criterion in public-sector and municipal tenders, which placed a category of business out of reach regardless of product quality.
work: Converted the full portal to bilingual English and Arabic with complete right-to-left layout across every screen.
Separated display values from wire values, so backend statuses continued to drive filtering and logic while only the rendered text was translated.
Isolated machine-facing date handling from display formatting, preventing locale-converted numerals from reaching backend APIs.
Delivered Arabic output across all four document paths — PDF, Excel, CSV and print — including correct Arabic glyph shaping in generated reports.
Added automated localization checks to the build so future releases cannot silently reintroduce untranslated content.

name: Dynamic Tracking Solutions
headline: Commercial vehicle tracking at operator scale
challenge: A tracking operator serving commercial customers needed a platform able to run a mixed device estate under one interface, with the reporting depth their own customers demanded and role separation between operator staff and end customers.
work: Deployed the 2M Fleet Telematics platform with multi-company separation so each end customer sees only their own vehicles.
Integrated across mixed GPS hardware rather than locking the operator to a single device supplier.
Configured the reporting suite around the reports their customers request most, with scheduled export.
Provided a customer portal so end users self-serve status instead of calling the operations desk.

name: Hawk I
headline: Tracking, recovery and command execution for a security-focused operator
challenge: A tracking operator whose customers buy on security outcomes needed reliable live positioning, immobiliser command execution with confirmation, and an alerting model that distinguishes genuine incidents from noise.
work: Deployed live tracking with continuous position updates and historical route replay for incident reconstruction.
Implemented remote immobilise and release with confirmation read from the vehicle's own reported state rather than the send response, removing a class of false success.
Configured geofencing and unauthorised-movement alerts with escalation, so operators act on signal rather than volume.
Delivered mobile access for field response teams.
